chunks.text: Create a Python virtual environment before installing backend dependencies. Activate the venv, then install requirements with pip.
Install frontend packages with npm before running the Vite development server or production build.
Use smollm2:135m as the tiny CPU friendly chat model for live Ollama smoke tests.
Use all-minilm as the tiny embedding model for CPU friendly retrieval smoke tests.
Document ingestion accepts text, Markdown, PDF, DOCX, HTML, CSV, and TSV files with file type sniffing.
OCRmyPDF can run as an optional low text PDF fallback when selected and available.
Keep API keys, generated indexes, uploaded files, and local credentials out of source control.
